context: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki review attendance and records.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business HR; vocabulary (勤務/バイト/出席/継続/文書) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の勤務状況は、どうかね?
lines.en: How is the staff's attendance status?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 皆、真面目に勤務しています。
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: バイトの人も、出席は良いかね?
lines.en: Is the part-timers' attendance good too?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: バイトの出席も、安定しています。
lines.style: clear office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 記録の文書は、残してあるかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、文書で継続的に残しています。
lines.en: Yes, I keep them continuously in documents.
lines.style: professional office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良い勤務を、継続してほしいな。
lines.en: I hope they continue working well.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 文書を整え、継続して管理します。
lines.en: I'll keep the documents in order and manage continuously.
lines.style: resolved office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
